title: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (Security) — Cernus runtime crosswalk
description: Common Criteria Cernus can evidence from runtime facts. A satisfied result is supporting evidence for the criterion, not an attestation.

controls.title: Detect and Prevent Unauthorized Software
controls.statement: Software on system components is inventoried and controlled. Checked: deployed images carry stored SBOMs.

controls.title: Identify Vulnerabilities and Configuration Susceptibilities
controls.statement: Vulnerability identification runs on a defined cadence. Checked: latest scan is within the freshness window.

controls.title: Monitor for Anomalies and Security Events
controls.statement: Ongoing monitoring re-evaluates known components. Checked: automated rescans exist for this system.

controls.title: Respond to Identified Security Incidents
controls.statement: Identified issues are tracked to resolution. Checked: open items are within windows or covered by an approved exception.

controls.title: Recover from Identified Security Incidents
controls.statement: Remediation completes within defined timeframes. Checked: no finding is past its remediation window.

controls.title: Authorize, Design, and Implement Changes
controls.statement: Changes are authorized and tested before deployment. Checked: the latest deployment has a change id and passed delivery gates.

controls.title: Protect Authentication Credentials
controls.statement: Credentials are protected from disclosure. Checked: no open embedded-secret findings.
